extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant can issue
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a £330,000 Reading estate, mostly the deceased's home, asks to borrow £76,500 to pay inheritance tax due by 14 November so the grant can issue.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about a probate loan in connection with the estate in Reading. We have noted the gross estate value of around £330,000, the £76,500 sought for inheritance tax, and the 14 November deadline. To take this further we would need confirmation of the deceased's details and date of death, the names of the executors, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, details of any existing charges on the property, the IHT400 or draft figures, and your firm's client due diligence. Once we have those we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
